title: 第四十三章 赔罪！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统

第(1/3)页

陈若彤道，“同时我已经和他开展合作，共同开了一家新的珠宝店，而且他已经解决货源问题。”

年轻人一愣，但很快露出冷笑，“彤姐，你这是在说梦话吗？我早查完他了，他就是个农村出身的土鳖！没任何背景，哪来的能耐解决货源问题！”

陈若彤冷冷道，“陈光，这世界藏龙卧虎之辈不知多少，你那点靠玩女人攒出来的人脉能查出什么？”

陈光大怒，陈若彤没理，看向陈华和陈杨，“父亲，二叔，我可以保证，我和他的店能开起来，而且以后的收益，绝不会比盛宝楼差。”

“我需要更好的理由！”

陈华凝重道，“小彤，你的话太模棱两可，我和家族其他人都无法接受。”

陈若彤一咬牙，她知道，不透叶凡的底是不行了，干脆道，“好，我直说，叶凡，是吕纯阳徒弟。”

众人呆住。

陈光愣了下，但下一刻他就哈哈大笑，“彤姐，你是不是精神错乱了！吕纯阳是什么人？那可是整天出入中央，给大人物治病的医道大家！他会收叶凡这种土鳖做徒弟？”

“大伯，二叔，你们不信，可以去调查，或者问王虎也可以，因为王虎也是吕纯阳徒弟，更是叶凡师兄。”

陈若彤还是不理陈光，再次道。

“什么！王虎竟是吕纯阳徒弟！”

“这是真的么！”

众人惊呼，他们当然知道王虎，不光是泉城一霸，在省内都极有份量！

这种人是吕纯阳徒弟，还是叶凡师兄，那叶凡确实不凡。

“我只要一年时间。”

陈若彤继续道，“我可以保证，一年内把生意做起来，而且未来潜力不会比盛宝楼差。”

“你要做不到呢？”

“那我自会听家族安排，和杨旭联烟。”陈若彤道。

陈家众人沉默，他们已不知怎么决定。

毕竟这消息太大，没人能想到王虎是吕纯阳徒弟，更没人想到叶凡也是吕纯阳徒弟。

“好！”陈华眼神一闪，“我们会派人调查，如果你说的是真的，叶凡确实是吕纯阳徒弟，行，这一年时间我给你，可要是假的…”

“我立刻和杨旭结婚！”陈若彤道。

“那就这么定了。”

陈华应声，陈若彤转身离开。

Chen Ruotong said, "At the same time, I have cooperated with him to open a new jewelry store, and he has solved the supply problem."

The young man was stunned for a moment, but soon sneered, "Sister Tong, are you talking in your sleep? I've already checked him out. He's just a country bumpkin from a rural area! Without any background, how can he be able to solve the supply problem!"

Chen Ruotong said coldly, "Chen Guang, there are so many hidden dragons and crouching tigers in this world. What can you find out with the contacts you have accumulated by playing with women?"

Chen Guang was furious, but Chen Ruotong ignored it and looked at Chen Hua and Chen Yang, "Father, second uncle, I can guarantee that his and I can open a store, and the future profits will never be worse than Shengbao Tower."

"I need a better reason!"

Chen Hua said solemnly, "Xiaotong, your words are too ambiguous. Neither I nor the rest of the family can accept it."

Chen Ruotong gritted her teeth. She knew that it was impossible not to reveal Ye Fan's background, so she simply said, "Okay, let me tell you straight, Ye Fan is Lu Chunyang's apprentice."

Everyone was stunned.

Chen Guang was stunned for a moment, but the next moment he burst into laughter, "Sister Tong, are you insane! Who is Lu Chunyang? He is a medical master who goes in and out of the center all day long to treat big shots! Will he accept a bumpkin like Ye Fan as his apprentice?"

"Uncle, second uncle, if you don't believe it, you can go investigate, or you can ask Wang Hu, because Wang Hu is also Lu Chunyang's apprentice, and he is senior brother Ye Fan."

Chen Ruotong still ignored Chen Guang and said again.

"What! Wang Hu is actually Lu Chunyang's apprentice!"

"Is this true?"

Everyone exclaimed, of course they knew that Wang Hu was not only the tyrant of Quancheng, but also very influential in the province!

This kind of person is Lu Chunyang's apprentice or Ye Fan's senior brother. Then Ye Fan is indeed extraordinary.

"I only need one year."

Chen Ruotong continued, "I can guarantee that the business will be launched within one year, and the future potential will not be worse than that of Shengbao Tower."

"What if you can't do it?"

"Then I will listen to the family's arrangements and join forces with Yang Xu." Chen Ruotong said.

Everyone in the Chen family was silent, they no longer knew how to decide.

After all, the news was too big. No one could have thought that Wang Hu was Lu Chunyang's apprentice, and no one would have thought that Ye Fan was also Lu Chunyang's apprentice.

"Okay!" Chen Hua's eyes flashed, "We will send people to investigate. If what you say is true and Ye Fan is indeed Lu Chunyang's apprentice, okay, I will give you this year, but if it is false..."

"I will marry Yang Xu immediately!" Chen Ruotong said.

"Then it's settled."

Chen Hua responded, and Chen Ruotong turned around and left.
